recent_game.fact: Missouri opened the 2026 season with a 54-14 win over Arkansas-Pine Bluff on Sept. 3.
Missouri produced 562 total yards, including 357 passing and 205 rushing, and converted 6 of 10 third downs against Arkansas-Pine Bluff.
Missouri led Arkansas-Pine Bluff 40-0 at halftime after outgaining the Golden Lions 376-6 in the first half.
Missouri's defense held Arkansas-Pine Bluff to 198 total yards, 13 first downs and a 3-of-13 third-down conversion rate.

quarterback.fact: Ole Miss transfer Austin Simmons started Missouri's opener and completed 17 of 19 passes for 252 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions.
Simmons' 89.5% completion rate and 270.4 passer rating were the highest by a quarterback in a Missouri debut.
Missouri's depth chart lists Austin Simmons as the starting quarterback and sophomore Matt Zollers as the backup.
Zollers completed 8 of 12 passes for 87 yards and scored his first collegiate rushing touchdown in the opener.

Sophomore receiver Donovan Olugbode recorded his first career 100-yard receiving game and caught two touchdown passes in the opener.
